name: Rig control
author: HamDash
description: Frequency, mode, tuning and PTT for the selected radio

device.label: Listen: audio input
device.help: 'rig' plays the audio input set on the selected radio in Settings -> Radio, and moves with it when you change radios. If that radio has none set, the card says so rather than opening this machine's default input, which is usually a microphone. 'mock' is a test tone. The rest are this machine's own inputs, if the radio's guess is wrong.

rate.label: Listen: quality
rate.help: Samples per second sent to the browser. A receiver's audio is about 3 kHz wide, so 8000 carries all of it at 128 kbit/s; 12000 leaves headroom and costs 192. Higher is only worth it on a wired network.

buffer_ms.label: Listen: buffer (ms)
buffer_ms.help: How much audio to hold before playing, to ride out network jitter. Lower is more responsive; raise it if you hear dropouts. 120 ms is comfortable on a LAN, 300+ on patchy Wi-Fi.
